relations.subject: Joseph Héliodore Sagesse Vertu Garcin de Tassy
relations.evidence: He left for Paris in 1817 where he studied oriental languages under Silvestre de Sacy

relations.subject: Joseph Héliodore Sagesse Vertu Garcin de Tassy
relations.evidence: was awarded professorship for Indology at the School for Living Oriental Languages, that was founded for him.

relations.subject: Joseph Héliodore Sagesse Vertu Garcin de Tassy
relations.evidence: In 1838 he was elected to the Académie des Inscriptions et Belles-Lettres.

relations.subject: Joseph Héliodore Sagesse Vertu Garcin de Tassy
relations.evidence: was one of the founders and later president of the Société Asiatique.
